# DbLive

> DbLive is a .NET library (NuGet: DbLive, DbLive.MSSQL, DbLive.PostgreSQL, DbLive.xunit) for database lifecycle management on SQL Server and PostgreSQL: versioned SQL migrations with undo scripts, re-runnable code objects (procedures, functions, views), SQL unit tests that run in rolled-back transactions, also as xUnit tests against a temporary database built from the scripts (Docker or a local server), and a separate "breaking changes" phase for zero-downtime releases.

Start with `llms-full.txt`: it is a complete, self-contained reference written for AI coding agents (setup, file naming grammar, settings, transactions, test assertions, exceptions, recipes). The pages below are the human documentation; they cover the same facts in narrative form.

Key facts an agent must not get wrong:
- Scripts live in a `Scripts/` folder of a .NET project; the `.csproj` copies them to `<AssemblyName>.Scripts` and embeds `ProjectDir` metadata.
- Migration file names: `<version>.<type>.<name>.sql` with type `migration|m|undo|u|breaking|b`; settings of one script: `<version>.<type>.settings.json` (`<version>.m.s.json`), never `<version>.settings.json`. Applied migrations must never be edited or deleted.
- Code files are re-executed when they change, so they must be re-runnable (`create or alter`).
- Breaking (destructive) scripts run only with `DeployParameters.DeployBreaking = true`, after the old application is gone.
- SQL tests assert through a result set whose first column is named `assert` (`rows`, `rows-with-schema`, `has-rows`, `row-count=N`, `empty`, `single-row`).

## Docs

- [Complete reference for AI agents](https://zacoders.github.io/DbLive/llms-full.txt): everything in one file; read this first
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/gettingstarted.md): create a project, first migration, first deployment
- [Project structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/project/structure.md): folders and file naming rules
- [Project configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/project/configuration.md): `settings.json` keys, item settings (per migration, breaking or undo script), transactions
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/deployment/index.md): pipeline order, `DeployParameters`, presets
- [Migrations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/deployment/migrations.md): versions, undo, downgrade, checksums
- [Code deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/deployment/code.md): re-runnable objects, ordering, retries
- [Breaking changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/deployment/breaking-changes.md): the contract phase
- [Zero-downtime deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/deployment/zero-downtime.md): step-by-step runbook
- [SQL unit testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/unit-testing/index.md): assertions, `init.sql`, xUnit integration
- [Philosophy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/philosophy.md): database as a service, versioned procedure interface, expand/contract

## Examples

- [DemoMSSQL](https://github.com/zacoders/DbLive/tree/main/src/Demo/DemoMSSQL): SQL Server project with migrations, undo, breaking, code, tests, BeforeDeploy/AfterDeploy
- [DemoMSSQL.Tests](https://github.com/zacoders/DbLive/tree/main/src/Demo/DemoMSSQL.Tests): xUnit with `[SqlFact]`, `[SqlDeployFact]` and Testcontainers
- [Demo.PostgreSQL.Chinook](https://github.com/zacoders/DbLive/tree/main/src/Demo/Demo.PostgreSQL.Chinook): PostgreSQL project with timestamp versions
- [Table split example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacoders/DbLive/main/docs/examples/table-split.md): expand/contract walkthrough
